This article is a stub. Recreonics is an American distributor of pool and aquatic equipment that
sold [Siliconix](siliconix.md) stopwatches to swimmers in 1976 and advertised its own
[pace clock](../equipment/common/pace-clock/recreonics-pace-clock.md) in 1977.

See the [vendors](index.md) register for the companies this wiki covers.
